patient_education_status.detail: Teaching on inhaler technique and the COPD action plan completed

free_text_notes.physician_note: 82-year-old man with anxiety, osteoporosis, admitted 3/11 with COPD exacerbation triggered by viral bronchitis. Ambulated 100 m with PT yesterday without desaturation. 3/16 08:00: Desaturating to 84% with ambulation this morning, below baseline; needs re-evaluation before discharge.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. Patient worried about the cost of the new medication. A pharmacist conducted a regular medication review on day 2 as part of standard care. No issues were identified and no changes to the medication plan were recommended.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Met with patient and nephew to review the discharge plan. Patient asked what the new azithromycin 250 mg three times weekly is for; teaching still needed.
